data.name: Metonymy
data.detailed_description:
A combination of Dante’s Inferno, Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind and Fight Club, Metonymy follows Colin as he travels through the indoctrinated utopia of Sagacity on a quest to the vile and viscus center of the world known only as The Blood. He is joined by a few companions he meets along the way and with their help fights the oppressive Theocratic Choir and the insane and depraved Disease in an effort to reclaim his life before it’s too late.

Key Game Features

  • Cinematic Adventure: Players will experience a unique and engaging story that takes advantage of the foundations of interactive entertainment and film in order to bring its narrative and world to life unlike other games in its genre.
  • Interactive World: Players will be able to explore set locations and unravel the mysteries of Sagacity via delving into the dark cracks of its environments or talking to its inhabitants. The player will be rewarded with a clearer understanding of the overarching narrative and its unique characters.
  • Multiple Perspectives: While the story centers around Colin, players will be given unique insight into other inhabitants of the world of sagacity. Giving the players control of different protagonist serves to enrich the overall narrative of Metonymy and allows for a deeper understanding of the world and events that take place within it.
  • Rhythm Game Combat: The player will engage in combat in a sort of hybrid of action and rhythm games that lives seamlessly in the world of Metonymy. While combat will be limited to specific narrative beats, each time the player must fight the scene will be unique and choreographed to specific music that progresses the narrative.
  • Unique Visual Design: With Artistic influences form Harry Clarke, Goichi Suda, Zdzislaw Beksinski and Modernist Gothic Architecture, Metonymy aims to have a visual style all its own.

data.short_description: Metonymy follows the story of Colin, Enoch and Tracy as they travel across a dystopian version of limbo filled with a corrupt theocratic government known as the Choir and the unbreakable hordes of the disease that appose them.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Mínimos:
  • Sistema Operativo: Windows 10
  • Processador: Intel Core i7-6800k CPU 2 3.40GHz
  • Memória: 4 GB de RAM
  • Placa gráfica: ASUS GeForce GTX 1070
  • DirectX: Versão 11
  • Espaço no disco: Requer 1 GB de espaço livre
  • Placa de som: DirectX® 11 supported
  • Notas adicionais: Game pad support is optimized. Some features may not work as intended with Mouse and Keyboard.

reviews.review: Metonymy successfully delivers a highly stylized, dark adventure fix by blending raw point-and-click progression layouts with an ultra-surreal dystopian narrative focused on theological overtones and limbo exploration. While the unique low-poly geometry and striking art direction initially promise a deeply atmospheric sci-fi routine, spending exactly 35 minutes inside the client reveals that the conceptual framework struggles to provide meaningful gameplay engagement. The structural core drops players into a minimalist environment where progression triggers feel overly vague, tasking users with reading disjointed environmental logs rather than interacting with a polished gameplay loop.On the technical side, a deep dive into community feedback indicates a heavily polarized user reception due to severe structural limitations. While enthusiasts heavily praise the imaginative character designs and striking angular visual setups, the wider community log notes a critical lack of gameplay direction that leaves players wandering without coherent objectives. It operates as an uncompromising, low-budget indie prototype that values abstract storytelling over intuitive mechanical depth. While it respects your active Steam showcase by avoiding broken achievement filler, the final execution feels too empty to justify the deployment. Do not launch this deployment unless you are strictly searching for visual asset inspiration.
